agents.name: Intake
agents.role: Scout Intent: classifies and guards the request, and signs the contract that fixes the desk's authority

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Reads each customer's real SEC filings through Zetaris: revenue trend, profit, liquidity

agents.name: Collections
agents.role: Reads Halden's ledger through Zetaris: utilisation, lateness, past due, disputes, orders waiting

agents.name: Archivist
agents.role: H-MEM memory of past decisions and how they turned out; World Model case file

agents.name: Underwriter
agents.role: Proposes each decision on Nemotron Ultra, citing clauses and evidence

agents.name: Risk Officer
agents.role: Applies the policy and sector notes, disputes the model, overrules it if needed, flags approvals

agents.name: Executor
agents.role: Changes limits and orders within authority; raises approvals and drafts notices for the rest
